description:
Check an ad post for MAX against Russian ad marking rules: the 'Реклама' label at the top, advertiser details
    (name and INN/OGRN or a site), an erid token in the link or text, the A+ mark for channels over 10,000 subscribers,
    and the 4000-character limit. A hint, not legal advice; ORD registration is not checked.

advertiser_site.description: Site with the advertiser's details, if they are not in the text
advertiser_site.title: Advertiser Site

channel_has_a_plus.description: Whether the channel has the A+ mark (RKN registry)
channel_has_a_plus.title: Channel Has A Plus

channel_subscribers.description: Subscribers of the channel where it goes
channel_subscribers.title: Channel Subscribers

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

links.description: Links used in buttons or elsewhere, if not in the text
links.title: Links

text.description: Ad post text as it will be published
text.title: Text
